features.name: osrm_duration
features.how: duration of the OSRM driving route (car profile)

features.name: osrm_distance
features.how: distance of the OSRM driving route

features.name: haversine_km
features.how: straight-line distance, haversine formula, Earth radius 6371 km, from pickup and dropoff latitude/longitude

inputs_note: latitude and longitude are always passed as separate named arguments, never as [lng, lat] arrays
fallback_rule: use plain OSRM duration if any OSRM value is missing, negative or NaN, or any feature is outside input_ranges.json min/max
